rule: change.safety_fparameter_set writes an F-parameter only when it is listed here as qualified for the F-I/O's module catalog type (the F-I/O's own type identifier, else its direct parent's; an order number with firmware or a GSD identity) and the module declares it readable and writable; F-source addresses, signatures, SIL/CRC/version and F-I/O DB assignment are never written. A qualified row means one native write, readback and checkpoint restore passed with configured-hardware preservation; it does not validate, accept or approve a safety program. A pending row refuses until a native run re-curates it. Rows come from native runs only: scripts/probe_safety_fparameters.py discovers and round-trips, scripts/safety_fparameter_allowlist.py merges a curated run.
